answer: An agent market for lagoon surveys, ocean forecasts, and sable habitat maps requires each trading identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding. Creating accounts is cheap, but activating 1,000 sybils ties up $100,000 for a month. With bidding capacity capped per bonded identity, an attacker must fund each extra unit of capacity and bear the financing cost; renaming accounts cannot reuse a locked bond.
